# CPACC Mastery

> CPACC Mastery is a free study platform for the IAAP Certified Professional
> in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC) certification exam. It provides
> study guides and practice tests covering all three CPACC
> exam domains.

The site helps accessibility professionals prepare for the CPACC exam through
structured study content and practice questions
organized by domain and topic. All content is aligned with the official IAAP
CPACC Body of Knowledge.

## Study Domains

- [Domain 1: Disabilities, Challenges & Assistive Technologies](https://cpaccmastery.com/disabilities-challenges-assistive-technology): Covers theoretical models of disability, categories and characteristics of disabilities, assistive technologies, demographics and statistics, and disability etiquette.
- [Domain 2: Accessibility & Universal Design](https://cpaccmastery.com/accessibility-universal-design): Covers individual accommodations vs universal design, benefits of accessibility, WCAG principles, built environment accessibility, universal design principles, and UDL/UX.
- [Domain 3: Standards, Laws & Management Strategies](https://cpaccmastery.com/standards-laws-management-strategies): Covers international conventions, regional instruments, national/provincial laws, procurement laws, ICT standards, and integrating ICT accessibility.

## Features

- [Practice Test](https://cpaccmastery.com/cpacc-practice-test): Full mock exam and topic-specific quizzes covering all domains
- Study guides with detailed content for each of the 17 CPACC topics
- Text-to-speech for audio learning

## Domain 1 Topics

- [Theoretical Models of Disability](https://cpaccmastery.com/disabilities-challenges-assistive-technology/1a-theoretical-models): Medical, social, biopsychosocial, and other frameworks for understanding disability.
- [Categories & Characteristics of Disabilities](https://cpaccmastery.com/disabilities-challenges-assistive-technology/1b-categories-characteristics): Different disability categories, their characteristics, common barriers, and solutions.
- [Assistive Technologies & Adaptive Strategies](https://cpaccmastery.com/disabilities-challenges-assistive-technology/1c-assistive-technologies): Technologies and strategies enabling people with disabilities to access information.
- [Disability Demographics and Statistics](https://cpaccmastery.com/disabilities-challenges-assistive-technology/1d-demographics-statistics): Statistical data and demographic information related to disabilities worldwide.
- [Disability Etiquette](https://cpaccmastery.com/disabilities-challenges-assistive-technology/1e-disability-etiquette): Appropriate language, behaviors, and interactions regarding people with disabilities.

## Domain 2 Topics

- [Individual Accommodations vs Universal Design](https://cpaccmastery.com/accessibility-universal-design/2a-accommodations-universal-design): The difference between individual accommodations and universal design principles.
- [Benefits of Accessibility](https://cpaccmastery.com/accessibility-universal-design/2b-benefits-accessibility): Wide-ranging benefits of accessibility for individuals, organizations, and society.
- [Web Accessibility Principles (WCAG)](https://cpaccmastery.com/accessibility-universal-design/2c-wcag-principles): WCAG principles: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust (POUR).
- [Built Environment Accessibility](https://cpaccmastery.com/accessibility-universal-design/2d-built-environment): Accessibility principles for physical spaces, buildings, and infrastructure.
- [Principles of Universal Design](https://cpaccmastery.com/accessibility-universal-design/2e-universal-design-principles): The seven principles of universal design for inclusive products and environments.
- [Universal Design for Learning (UDL) + UX](https://cpaccmastery.com/accessibility-universal-design/2f-udl-ux): UDL principles integrated with user experience design for accessible education.

## Domain 3 Topics

- [International Declarations and Conventions](https://cpaccmastery.com/standards-laws-management-strategies/3a-international-conventions): International treaties and conventions related to disability rights, including the UN CRPD.
- [Regional Instruments on Human & Disability Rights](https://cpaccmastery.com/standards-laws-management-strategies/3b-regional-instruments): Regional agreements protecting disability rights across different parts of the world.
- [National & Provincial Instruments](https://cpaccmastery.com/standards-laws-management-strategies/3c-national-provincial): National and provincial laws governing accessibility and disability rights.
- [Domain-specific & Government Procurement Laws](https://cpaccmastery.com/standards-laws-management-strategies/3d-procurement-laws): Accessibility requirements and government procurement laws for accessible products.
- [Applying Accessibility Standards to ICT](https://cpaccmastery.com/standards-laws-management-strategies/3e-ict-standards): How to apply accessibility standards to ICT products and services.
- [Integrating ICT Accessibility Across the Organisation](https://cpaccmastery.com/standards-laws-management-strategies/3f-integrating-ict): Strategies for embedding ICT accessibility in organisational policies and culture.
